summary: Retested the requested backend and UI regressions. All 17 backend tests passed; request creation now appends the new row immediately, valid mocked OTP works, authenticated desktop payment shows its toast, CORS is environment-driven, and mobile navigation works. Mobile provider hiring remains blocked because its hire panel is rendered as an aside hidden by the mobile sidebar rule.

integration_issues.issue: The provider detail hire panel is an <aside>, but @media(max-width:800px) sets all aside elements to display:none; mobile users cannot reach Send hire request or complete mocked UPI payment.

action_items: Change the mobile sidebar selector to target the navigation sidebar specifically (for example, a sidebar class) so the provider hire panel remains visible on mobile and its payment button is reachable.
critical_code_review_comments: Avoid using the generic HTML aside selector for both the app sidebar and content panels; the mobile rule currently hides unrelated functional content.

success_rate.frontend: 90% of exercised flows; mobile provider payment blocked

seed_data_creation: Created mocked TEST_ requests and transactions during regression testing; state is process-local.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 3 confirms request-row immediate rendering, CORS_ORIGINS wildcard behavior without credentials, valid OTP, authenticated desktop payment/toast, insights navigation, and mobile navigation. Retest mobile provider detail after separating the sidebar CSS selector from .hire-panel. All integrations remain explicitly MOCKED (OTP and UPI/contact reveal).
rca of the issue: The mobile stylesheet uses aside{display:none} to hide the desktop navigation sidebar. ProviderDetail also uses an aside element for the hire panel, so the broad selector hides the payment CTA on mobile. Narrowing the selector to the actual sidebar preserves the hire panel.
cors_verification: OPTIONS requests from arbitrary and preview origins returned Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * with no Access-Control-Allow-Credentials header, sourced from backend CORS_ORIGINS=*.
setup_note: The first local pytest invocation lacked an exported REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL; rerunning with frontend/.env value passed all 17 tests.
